entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into the return options for you. To get started, could you help me understand the reason for the return? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken, it just isn't what I was hoping for. Honestly, I find it confusing.
I see. I appreciate you sharing that. What specifically about the device is confusing or hard to use for you? Sometimes there are settings we can adjust to make it a better fit.
Look, I read the user manual. I just expected more. I can't see my live heart rate zones when I'm actually on the bike. It just gives me a summary at the end. I need to see it in the moment.

Ah, that is an excellent question and a very common one. You are correct that the default screen shows your summary stats. To see your live data, you just need to swipe left on the screen while your workout is active. The third screen shows the color-coded heart rate zones in real-time.
Swipe? The manual didn't mention that. Hold on, let me try it... Okay. I see it. The colored bars.

That's the one. That screen is designed to give you that immediate feedback to adjust your intensity. You can also customize those data screens in the VeloFit app if you'd prefer to see a different metric on the first or second swipe.
Okay, that's actually what I wanted. It's not so hard to use when you know that. That's much better. Fine, I'll keep it. No return needed.
I'm so glad we could get that sorted out for you! It's a powerful little device once you get past that initial learning curve. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and enjoy your ride.
